kjv: which dwell in the champaign over against Gilgal, beside the plains of Moreh
mine: who live in the Arabah, opposite Gilgal, beside the oak of Moreh
note: ha'aravah is the Jordan rift valley, and 'elonei moreh is the oak (terebinth) of Moreh (cf. Gen 12:6). The KJV's "plains" again follows the Targum.
